$comment: Soft style: new. Light, warm, rounded and calm for readers outside finance (HR, people, wellbeing, internal services).

meta.label: Soft
meta.summary: Warm page, rounded cards, calm colours, generous spacing and larger text; IBCS notation kept in a softer ink. Light: off-white and white cards; dark: warm charcoal.

relaxes.what: Warm off-white page behind white cards (dark: warm charcoal with slightly lighter cards).
relaxes.why: Calm, familiar look for non-finance readers; charts sit on white.

relaxes.what: AC in a soft blue-grey ink (#4A4E69 light, #E4E0EE dark) instead of a neutral dark grey.
relaxes.why: The calmer ink is the style; the tint is low-saturation, far from every impact hue, and AC stays clearly stronger than PY (checked).
relaxes.condition: Never a second colour for a second series; further scenarios keep their IBCS fills.

relaxes.what: Rounded cards (18–24 px) with one soft shadow; bar ends rounded 4 px.
relaxes.why: Chrome softness; a 4 px radius on a bar of 20+ px keeps the length readable.
relaxes.condition: No radius on bars thinner than 8 px.

relaxes.why: Readers outside finance, often on phones.

relaxes.what: Generous spacing; at most 4 visuals a page.
relaxes.why: Lower density is the point of the style; split a dense page into two. Lower density never means filler: every element carries a message.

relaxes.what: Faint horizontal gridlines where data labels are dropped for readability.
relaxes.why: Helps readers who do not read value labels first.
relaxes.condition: Gridlines or data labels on a visual, never both.
Off under prefers-reduced-motion; numbers are final from the first frame.
